items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: I don't know too much about her.

ctx.x: No, she died. Did she? Because when I was in Danforth, she died about five years ago.
Oh, I didn't know that. His sister, I think, was here several years ago, or a cousin or something. But, uh... Yeah. I don't know too much about her. Yeah. His sister is living in Lexington, Mass.

Is she? Yeah. And I think she has possession of one of his horns, you know, his cornets. One of his cornets is down in the Jazz Museum in New Orleans. I guess it was one he played with Ben Pollack for a short time, when he was playing with Ben Pollack.
